EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 452 July 8, 1975
EXTENDING THE TERM OF THE PRESIDENTIAL COMMISSION ON REORGANIZATION
CREATED UNDER EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 281, SERIES OF 1970
WHEREAS, under P. D. No. 1, the President has the authority to change provisions of the Integrated
Reorganization Plan (IRP) in order to conform with the changing requirements of the Government for
accelerated socio-economic development;
WHEREAS, the Office of the President continues to receive proposals from the various departments and
agencies of the national government which have reorganizational implications such as the abolition, creation,
or expansion of agencies;
WHEREAS, simultaneous with the submission of the above-mentioned proposals is the fact that several
departments and agencies continue to consult with the Presidential Commission on reorganization on the
operational difficulties they have been meeting in the implementation of the IRP;
WHEREAS, two major departments, Education and Culture, and Trade have just recently been granted
authority for full implementation of IRP provisions affecting them; and
WHEREAS, the Office of the President needs the continued staff assistance of the Presidential Commission
on Reorganization in the evaluation of the above-mentioned proposals, in the provisions of technical services
in the implementation of the IRP, and in the monitoring of the government's program on administrative
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby extend the term of the Presidential Commission on
Reorganization up to June 30, 1976.
The Executive Secretary shall issue the necessary directives for the detail or the extension of the detail of such
technical personnel as may be needed by the Commission, under the same conditions as prescribed in
Executive Order No. 281, as amended.
The Commission is authorized to disburse and defray all expenses for its operation from July 1, 1975 to June
30, 1976 from funds as may be available from the Office of the President.
Done in the City of Manila, this 8th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-five.
